1.text: Paul, N Silvanus, N Timotheus, 2 tha church of tha Thessalonians which is in God tha Father N in tha Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be 2 u, N peace, from God our Father, N tha Lord Jesus Christ.
We give thanks 2 God always 4 u all, makin mention of u in our prayers;
Remembering without ceasing ur work of faith, N labour of love, N patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in tha sight of God N our Father;
Knowin, brothers beloved, ur election of God.
4 our gospel came not 2 u in word only, but also in power, N in tha Holy Ghost, N in much assurance; as y’all know what manner of men we were among u 4 ur sake.
N y’all became followers of us, N of tha Lord, havin received tha word in much affliction, wit joy of tha Holy Ghost:
So dat y’all were ensamples 2 all dat believe in Macedonia N Achaia.
4 from u sounded out tha word of tha Lord not only in Macedonia N Achaia, but also in every place ur faith 2 God-ward is spread abroad; so dat we need not 2 speak any thing.
4 dey themselves show of us what manner of entering in we had 2 u, N how y’all turned 2 God from idols 2 serve tha livin N true God;
N 2 wait 4 his Son from heaven, whom he raised from tha dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from tha wrath 2 come.

2.text: 4 y’all, brothers, know our entrance in 2 u, dat it was not in vain:
But even after dat we had suffered before, N were shamefully entreated, as y’all know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God 2 speak 2 u tha gospel of God wit much contention.
4 our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
But as we were allowed of God 2 be put in trust wit tha gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
4 neither at any time used we flattering words, as y’all know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
Nor of men sought we glory, neither of u, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as tha apostles of Christ.
But we were gentle among u, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
So bein affectionately desirous of u, we were willin 2 have imparted 2 u, not tha gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because y’all were dear 2 us.
4 y’all remember, brothers, our labour N travail: 4 labouring night N day, because we would not be chargeable 2 any of u, we preached 2 u tha gospel of God.
y’all r witnesses, N God also, how holily N justly N unblameably we behaved ourselves among u dat believe:
As y’all know how we exhorted N comforted N charged every one of u, as a father does his children,
Dat y’all would walk worthy of God, who has called u 2 his kingdom N glory.

4 dis cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when y’all received tha word of God which y’all heard of us, y’all received it not as tha word of men, but as it is in truth, tha word of God, which effectually works also in u dat believe.
4 y’all, brothers, became followers of tha churches of God which in Judaea r in Christ Jesus: 4 y’all also have suffered like things of ur own countrymen, even as dey have of tha Jews:
Who both killed tha Lord Jesus, N their own prophets, N have persecuted us; N dey please not God, N r contrary 2 all men:
Forbidding us 2 speak 2 tha Gentiles dat dey might be saved, 2 fill up their sins alway: 4 tha wrath is come upon ’em 2 tha uttermost.
But we, brothers, bein taken from u 4 a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured tha more abundantly 2 see ur face wit great desire.
So we would have come 2 u, even I Paul, once N again; but Satan hindered us.
4 what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicin? r not even y’all in tha presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his comin?
4 y’all r our glory N joy.

3.text: So when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good 2 be left at Athens alone;
N sent Timotheus, our brother, N minister of God, N our fellowlabourer in tha gospel of Christ, 2 establish u, N 2 comfort u concerning ur faith:
Dat no man should be moved by dese afflictions: 4 y’all know dat we r appointed thereunto.
4 for real, when we were wit u, we told u before dat we should suffer tribulation; even as it happened, N y’all know.
4 dis cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent 2 know ur faith, lest by some means tha tempter have tempted u, N our labour be in vain.
But now when Timotheus came from u 2 us, N brought us good tidings of ur faith N charity, N dat y’all have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly 2 see us, as we also 2 see u:
Therefore, brothers, we were comforted over u in all our affliction N distress by ur faith:
4 now we live, if y’all stand fast in tha Lord.
4 what thanks can we render 2 God again 4 u, 4 all tha joy wherewith we joy 4 ur sakes before our God;
Night N day prayin exceedingly dat we might see ur face, N might perfect dat which is lacking in ur faith?
Now God himself N our Father, N our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way 2 u.
N tha Lord make u 2 increase N abound in love one toward another, N toward all men, even as we do toward u:
2 tha end he may stablish ur hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at tha comin of our Lord Jesus Christ wit all his saints.

4.text: Furthermore then we beg u, brothers, N exhort u by tha Lord Jesus, dat as y’all have received of us how y’all ought 2 walk N 2 please God, so y’all would abound more N more.
4 y’all know what commandments we gave u by tha Lord Jesus.
4 dis is tha will of God, even ur sanctification, dat y’all should abstain from fornication:
Dat every one of u should know how 2 possess his vessel in sanctification N honour;
Not in tha lust of concupiscence, even as tha Gentiles which know not God:
Dat no man go beyond N defraud his brother in any matter: because dat tha Lord is tha avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned u N testified.
4 God has not called us 2 uncleanness, but 2 holiness.
He therefore dat despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who has also given 2 us his holy Spirit.
But as touching brotherly love y’all need not dat I write 2 u: 4 y’all y’all r taught of God 2 love one another.
N indeed y’all do it toward all tha brothers which r in all Macedonia: but we beg u, brothers, dat y’all increase more N more;
N dat y’all study 2 be quiet, N 2 do ur own business, N 2 work wit ur own hands, as we commanded u;
Dat y’all may walk honestly toward ’em dat r without, N dat y’all may have lack of nothing.
But I would not have u 2 be ignorant, brothers, concerning ’em which r asleep, dat y’all sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
4 if we believe dat Jesus died N rose again, even so ’em also which sleep in Jesus will God bring wit him.
4 dis we say 2 u by tha word of tha Lord, dat we which r alive N remain 2 tha comin of tha Lord shall not prevent ’em which r asleep.
4 tha Lord himself shall descend from heaven wit a shout, wit tha voice of tha archangel, N wit tha trump of God: N tha dead in Christ shall rise first:
Then we which r alive N remain shall be caught up together wit ’em in tha clouds, 2 meet tha Lord in tha air: N so shall we ever be wit tha Lord.
So comfort one another wit dese words.

5.text: But of tha times N tha seasons, brothers, y’all have no need dat I write 2 u.
4 y’all know perfectly dat tha day of tha Lord so comes as a thief in tha night.
4 when dey shall say, Peace N safety; then sudden destruction comes upon ’em, as travail upon a woman wit child; N dey shall not escape.
But y’all, brothers, r not in darkness, dat dat day should overtake u as a thief.
y’all r all tha children of light, N tha children of tha day: we r not of tha night, nor of darkness.
Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch N be sober.
4 dey dat sleep sleep in tha night; N dey dat be drunken r drunken in tha night.
But let us, who r of tha day, be sober, puttin on tha breastplate of faith N love; N 4 an helmet, tha hope of salvation.
4 God has not appointed us 2 wrath, but 2 obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
Who died 4 us, dat, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together wit him.
So comfort y’all together, N edify one another, even as also y’all do.
N we beg u, brothers, 2 know ’em which labour among u, N r over u in tha Lord, N admonish u;
N 2 esteem ’em very highly in love 4 their work’s sake. N be at peace among y’all.
Now we exhort u, brothers, warn ’em dat r unruly, comfort tha feebleminded, support tha weak, be patient toward all men.
See dat none render evil 4 evil 2 any man; but ever follow dat which is good, both among y’all, N 2 all men.
Rejoice evermore.
Pray without ceasing.
In every thing give thanks: 4 dis is tha will of God in Christ Jesus concerning u.
Quench not tha Spirit.
Despise not prophesyings.
Prove all things; hold fast dat which is good.
Abstain from all appearance of evil.
N tha very God of peace sanctify u wholly; N I pray God ur whole spirit N soul N body be preserved blameless 2 tha comin of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Faithful is he dat calls u, who also will do it.
Brothers, pray 4 us.
Greet all tha brothers wit an holy kiss.
I charge u by tha Lord dat dis epistle be read 2 all tha holy brothers.
Tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit u. Amen.
